chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ibn Fazzal, from one of his companions, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said to Musa: 'Increase your remembrance of Me by night and by day, and be humble during My remembrance, and be patient during My afflictions, and find peace during My remembrance, and worship Me and do not associate anything with Me. To Me is the final return. O Musa! Make Me your treasure and place your store of lasting righteous deeds with Me.'
ai.seo_question: What are the key instructions Allah gave to Musa regarding remembrance and worship?
ai.summary: This Qudsi hadith from al-Kafi underscores the spiritual discipline of constant dhikr and khushu', linking inner tranquility with exclusive worship (tawhid). It introduces the concept of 'al-baqiyat al-salihat' (lasting righteous deeds) as a divine treasure, reflecting the Shia emphasis on accumulating enduring merit for the afterlife through consistent devotion and patience during trials.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ibn Fazzal, from one of his companions, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said to Musa<sup>as</sup>: “Mention Me<sup>azwj</sup> frequently by the night and the day and become fearful during My<sup>azwj</sup> Mention, and observe patience during My<sup>azwj</sup> afflictions, and rest assured during My<sup>azwj</sup> Mention, and worship Me<sup>azwj</sup> and do not associate anything with Me<sup>azwj</sup>. O Musa<sup>as</sup>! Make Me<sup>azwj</sup> as your<sup>as</sup> Enshrinement and place your<sup>as</sup> treasures with Me<sup>azwj</sup> from the lasting righteous deeds’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from ibn Faddal from certain individuals of his people from those whom he has mentioned (in his book) from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, said to Moses, ‘Speak of Me a great deal during the day and night and be humble when speaking of Me, exercise patience with My misfortunes, be confident when speaking of Me, worship Me and do not consider anything as My partner. To Me is the way. O Moses, consider Me as your savings and keep your treasures with Me in the form of charitable trust.’”
